statement: For the 0/1 knapsack problem, sorting the items by decreasing value-to-weight ratio and greedily taking every item that still fits yields an optimal solution.
definitions: Instance = capacity W and items with positive integer weight and value; a feasible solution is a subset of total weight <= W; optimal = maximum total value. Greedy = scan items in non-increasing value/weight ratio (ties arbitrary) and take an item iff it fits in the remaining capacity.
